about: B78 (C10.1 row 7; P-343 (10), P-319): the names a person gives the 65 sections (29 from B78; 30 from B79b for Family sponsorship's IMM 5532 and IMM 5604, 15 each; 6 from BK-16 for IMM 1295 (09-2023), the Study permit spouse's work permit application, whose printed headings sit where its twin IMM 1294's do; its three work sections, one of them under a printed heading, take a Sample name of their own, not the printed "Details of intended work in Canada", so they never join the section With an LMIA's IMM 5710 asks, P-496) the rules pass holds because it read no printed heading over their form fields. The configured checkpoint's loader gives each through the same naming edit a person uses on To review (POST /api/review/proposals/decide, action edit). Each entry is one section: its form edition and its first form field. A name the library already holds lands on that section. A section with no entry here stays waiting on To review and is listed on row 7. An entry also names a section the form does print a heading over (BK-16: a person renames it), its name taking the place of the printed one.
basis: printed: the words the form itself prints above or beside these form fields, read from its XFA template on 5 Nov 2026 (official-sources/ircc/forms, IMM 5476 (11-2021) from its previous-editions folder; page is the page of the form's template that prints the words; the banner is on the page but not in the part the heading reader looks in). sample: a person's wording built from the form's own captions, Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. IMM 5532 (02-2021)'s template is one flowing page, so it gives no page breaks: its pages are from IMM 5533 (09-2022) p. 10 ("Page 3, question 9 (Declaration of sponsor)", "Page 4, question 5 (Declaration of applicant)"); the yes/no group and tables take the form's title printed on page 1; Part C's page 5 is inferred (it follows Part B's page-4 declaration).
